svg.title: Routing agreement on ERNIE-4.5-21B before and after the fix
svg.desc: Across 27 MoE layers, SGLang main agrees with transformers on 55.9% to 84.3% of prompt tokens per layer (67.5% overall); with the fix, 92.0% to 97.5% (94.3% overall).
svg.text: THE UPSTREAM FIX · BAIDU/ERNIE-4.5-21B-A3B-PT · ONE H100
Routing agreement with transformers, per MoE layer
Share of prompt tokens whose routed experts equal transformers’ (324 tokens × 27 MoE layers; bf16 checkpoint, fp32 router)
Decode tokens: 65.0% → 93.8%. Six short prompts plus 32 greedy tokens each; one run per build. Measured for the SGLang PR.
